flight.headline: Urban flight, in balance.
flight.title: One flight. An urban air network.
flight.imageAlt: Published reinforcement-learning framework linking energy, passenger comfort, modeled noise, safety and travel time.
flight.sceneAlt: Future concept: a rotorcraft follows a route over buildings, with wind streams and a noise footprint below.
flight.description: The paper studies trade-offs in simulated flight planning. Environmental modeling, aircraft validation, and city operations require weather, acoustics, flight-control, airspace and infrastructure expertise. A rotorcraft above buildings is connected to a dashed route, wind lines, and a noise footprint to illustrate the future network. Real flight, takeoff and landing validation are outside the present study.
